reason: Most days I just buy a plate downstairs for 50-60 baht, and when I do cook, mum's recipes on LINE, YouTube and the two free dishes are enough. I won't pay 99 baht a month for an app I'd open maybe twice.
objection: I can watch a free video for this, and mum already sends me recipes. Making green curry or tom yum just for me probably costs more in ingredients than buying a plate for 50 baht, so why pay to learn it?
would_change_my_mind: If the Sunday cook-ahead plan really fed me for the whole week for less than buying street food, so the 99 baht paid for itself.
